commits.message:
fix(rule): Rule's line in rule.line, its title in rule.text, as Rich (rich-rule-koc0) (#343)

* fix(rule): Rule draws its line in rule.line and its title in rule.text, as Rich does (rich-rule-koc0)

Rich 9d8f9a3 defaults Rule's style to "rule.line" (bright_green) and reads
a string title with render_str(style="rule.text") (null), appending it to the
line on its own. The port drew an unstyled line and laid the line's style
under the title; its theme had rule.line green and rule.text bold. A centred
title's gaps now leave in the same run as the line beside them, as Rich's do.

* fix(rule): resolve rule.line and rule.text as Rich does, and keep demo titles styled (rich-rule-koc0)

Review (high) on #343. The line style now resolves through resolveStyle, so a
theme without rule.line draws unstyled where getStyle threw; rule.text goes in
as a name and only an unhighlighted string title takes it, as Rich's
render_str drops the base style when it highlights. docs/console.md said the
title skips markup and takes style; both were false. Demos that styled a title
through style now style it through markup or a RichText.
